title: Dimension-Free Rank Lifting from Random Hyperplane Arrangements
abstract: arXiv:2609.39855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the width required for a randomly initialized hidden layer of a neural network to achieve rank lifting. Namely, given a dataset $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times d}$ of $m$, $d$-dimensional input vectors separated by an angle of at least $\theta$, we consider the random feature matrix $\sigma(XR)$, where $R$ is standard Gaussian. For positively homogeneous nonpolynomial activations, which include sign, Heaviside, ReLU, and ReLU powers among others, we prove that $$n \gtrsim \frac{1}{\theta}\max\left\{m,\log\left(\frac{1}{\delta}\right)\right\}$$ neurons suffice for $\sigma(XR)$ to have full row rank $m$ with probability at least $1-\delta$. This dimension-free bound exponentially improves the previous general-dimensional guarantee for sign features (Drago et al., 2026) and is essentially tight. The proof shows that one random feature column escapes every proper subspace of $\mathbb{R}^m$ with probability $\Omega(\theta)$, using a coup

translated_title: 来自随机超平面排列的无维度秩提升
translated_abstract: 我们研究了随机初始化的神经网络隐藏层实现秩提升所需的宽度。具体而言，给定一个由 m 个 d 维输入向量组成、且各向量之间夹角至少为 θ 的数据集 X ∈ R^(m×d)，我们考虑随机特征矩阵 σ(XR)，其中 R 为标准高斯随机矩阵。对于正齐次非多项式激活函数（包括 sign、Heaviside、ReLU 以及 ReLU 的幂等），我们证明 n ≳ (1/θ)·max{m, log(1/δ)} 个神经元足以使 σ(XR) 以至少 1−δ 的概率达到满行秩 m。这一与维度无关的界相比先前针对 sign 特征的一般维度保证（Drago 等，2026）实现了指数级改进，并且本质上是紧的。证明表明单个随机特征列以 Ω(θ) 的概率逃逸出 R^m 的每一个真子空间，使用了一种……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了对于 sign、ReLU 等正齐次非多项式激活函数，仅需约 (1/θ)·max{m, log(1/δ)} 个随机神经元即可使随机特征矩阵以高概率达到满行秩，首次建立了与输入维度无关的秩提升保证，相比先前结果有指数级改进且本质上达到最优。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that for positively homogeneous nonpolynomial activations such as sign and ReLU, about (1/θ)·max{m, log(1/δ)} random neurons suffice for the random feature matrix to achieve full row rank with high probability, establishing the first dimension-free rank-lifting guarantee that exponentially improves prior bounds and is essentially tight.
